long_biography.plain_text:
Chapman Ducote built Merchant Services LTD into a nationwide credit-card processor. After studying at the University of Miami and working in investment banking and equities trading, he returned to South Florida, completed several property developments and established the company. Private-equity-backed Talus Payments acquired it in 2019.

Ducote had created War Chest Real Estate alongside the payments business. The commercial-property platform buys retail, industrial and office assets, using leasing and repositioning to improve operations. Its purchases have included shopping centres in Indiana and Utah. The business brought Ducote back to the property field he entered before Merchant Services and made real-estate investment his continuing commercial focus.

The dossier therefore supports current Real Estate activity but does not assert an exact continuing War Chest stake or management mandate.

Founder is historically certain for Merchant Services and War Chest, but Merchant Services was sold and War Chest's present governance is unsettled. Investor is used at medium confidence because Ducote's current materials describe sustained commercial-property and private-equity capital allocation, independently corroborated by War Chest acquisitions.
